entities.summary: Toyotomi Hideyoshi, a notable figure in the history of South Korea, associated with Joseon Dynasty (1592–1598). Preceded by Imjin War and Admiral Yi Sun-sin and King Sejong the Great promulgates Hangul — the Korean alphabet. Their legacy influenced Late Joseon and Hermit Kingdom and Manchu.
